title: A staff-waived Space can price a Journey, like every other money path it already may

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), pricing ladder review of #3284 (LIVE-822).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: LIVE-822 lets staff waive a Space's limits, and the payments gate then lets that Space sell shop items, tickets and memberships at the Collective level. checkJourneySell read the raw plan into resolveJourneyAccess, so the same waived free Space was refused at 'set a Journey price', the one money path that disagreed. THE FIX: the sell gate reads limitsWaivedPlan(plan) when spaceLimitsWaived is true, the same lift the payments gate applies.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/journeys/sell-gate.ts','utf8');if(!/\(await spaceLimitsWaived\(spaceId\)\) \? limitsWaivedPlan\(space\.plan\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-820: the Journey sell gate ignores a staff waiver');process.exit(1)}"
